title: Phase One — Chessed Boundless Brainstorm

headings.text: AI that authors real movies, not fake snippets
Procedural core as the true asset foundry
Awtsmoos UI as a JSON vessel
Three-minute proof as a living integration test
Extreme future possibilities worth preserving without overbuilding now

excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Phase One — Chessed Boundless Brainstorm The Awtsmoos makes a frame from naught, then births the next before it ends; Awtsmoos.com can become a cinema language where every studio shares the truth yet keeps its friends. This pass intentionally explores the largest useful possibility space
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase one — chessed boundless brainstorm the awtsmoos makes a frame from naught, then births the next before it ends; awtsmoos.com can become a cinema language where every studio shares the truth yet keeps its friends. this pass intentionally explores the largest useful possibility space before narrowing implementation. one movie language, many pets imagine one declarative awtsmoosmovie document understood by every movie capable app. the document contains scenes, reusable actors, assets, layers, tracks, cameras, lights, captions, sound cues, transitions, behaviors, keyframes, particles, diagrams, charts, and render hints. each app presents a different personality over that common truth: animator remains the character/performance/directing pet: gestures, gait, facial performance, procedural people, cameras, expressive animation. nesher studio remains the post production/media pet: ingest, tracks, effects, recording, audio mix, export, webcodecs, delivery. video editor remains the compact timeline pet: fast trim, arrange, captions, simple assembly. mitzvah studio remains the structured visual authoring pet: objects, canvas composition, inspector, reusable documents. awtsmoos studio becomes the flagship orchestration pet: ai prompt → canonical movie → interactive editing → preview → export, with access to shared capabilities from all the others. ai that authors real movies, not fake snippets the ai path should never require arbitrary executable js. a model writes structured json, receives path specific validation feedback, repairs invalid nodes, and can ask for capability discovery. a canonical capability catalog tells the model exactly which scene node types, properties, transitions, cameras, generators, effects, and render targets exist. potential ai workflow: 1. user prompt describes movie intent. 2. planner emits story beats and a duration budget. 3. asset planner chooses procedural people, props, text, diagrams, charts, particles, and environments. 4. scene compiler creates normalized scenes. 5. validator emits machine readable errors and warnings. 6. repair pass fixes invalid paths. 7. timeline compiler produces deterministic scene local time. 8. renderer adapters consume the same normalized movie. 9. export adapter captures/encodes frames and audio. engine neutral cinematic vocabulary the movie document can support: 2d primitives: rectangle, rounded rectangle, ellipse, line, path, polygon, arrow, brace, mask, clipping patch. text primitives: title, paragraph, caption, label, code/tutorial block, highlighted word runs, counters, kinetic typography. data graphics: bars, lines, pies/donuts, gauges, timelines, flow diagrams, nodes/edges, progress rings, comparison tables. people/characters: human procedural actors, stylized avatars, rig references, pose/action cues, speech metadata. 3d primitives: box, sphere, cylinder, extrusions, procedural architecture, rocks, vegetation, fluids, particles, imported models. cameras: wide, close up, extreme close up, profile, over shoulder, top down, low angle, high angle, orbit, dolly, crane, handheld like procedural motion. lights: ambient, key/fill/rim, point, spot, directional, emissive cues. particles: emitter presets, trails, sparks, confetti, dust, smoke like sprites, orbit fields, procedural energy motifs. transitions: cut, dissolve, wipe, push, iris, morph like cross composition, matched camera motion. animation: keyframes, easing, path motion, spring like motion, stagger, reveal, count up, chart growth, type on, rig actions. audio intent: narration cues, music sections, sound effect cues, gain envelopes, ducking metadata. procedural core as the true asset foundry move no code merely for the sake of relocation. instead, make every generic generator addressable through stable shared contracts. existing core systems already reveal geometry, people, text, particles, animation, physics, materials, reality json, camera, and asset services. the movie system should point into those capabilities using portable asset descriptors. possible asset descriptor: stable id semantic kind generator namespace generation recipe optional deterministic seed dimensions/bounds hints quality profile adapter hints cache key this lets ai say “generate a teacher character”, “create a 3d city block”, “emit gold particles”, or “build an infographic arrow” through declarative intent rather than implementation knowledge. awtsmoos ui as a json vessel create or extend a shared ui grammar where pages are data, not repeated dom boilerplate. a ui recipe can describe: shells, headers, toolbars, docks, sheets, drawers, tabs, split panes, canvases, timelines, lists, forms, inspectors, modals, toasts. semantic actions rather than inline listeners. responsive rules and mobile priorities. accessibility labels/roles. state bindings and conditional visibility. repeaters for arrays and keyed collections. slots for app specific custom renderers. token themes and density profiles. the renderer should be small, strict, and secure: known element tags, controlled attributes, action registry, text vs html separation, no arbitrary script execution. mobile first cinematic ux a phone should not be a shrunk desktop. potential design: full screen preview canvas with gesture seek/play. bottom sheet timeline with magnetic scene snapping. thumb friendly primary actions. one tap switch between prompt, scenes, timeline, assets, inspector, export. inspector as drill down sheet rather than permanent side column. scene thumbnails generated lazily. compact ai command composer always reachable. landscape mode unlocks dual pane preview + timeline. desktop progressively adds docks, multi pane views, keyboard shortcuts, and larger timeline lanes. three minute proof as a living integration test the 180 second movie should intentionally traverse the entire vocabulary: opening cosmic particles, a 3d city or landscape, characters entering, a narrated tutorial board, animated shapes and callouts, data charts, a split screen explanation, camera orbit, close up dialogue/performance, procedural environment, particle climax, recap cards, credits. the movie should be authored from split scene files to honor small module discipline while still compiling into one canonical movie document. extreme future possibilities worth preserving without overbuilding now ai storyboard thumbnails before full render. deterministic render farm/headless renderer. collaborative edits with crdt like patches. reusable cinematic templates. semantic “shot intent” to camera realization. motion capture import adapters. subtitle translation tracks. vector/svg export for infographic scenes. webgpu rendering adapters. offline render queue. automatic aspect ratio reframing for vertical/social formats. provenance and reproducibility manifests for ai generated assets. phase one conclusion: build a narrow canonical grammar with extensible registries, not an impossible monolith. let the awtsmoos be one source of truth while the keilim—the apps—remain beautifully distinct.
